description: What the user OWNS, as opposed to what moved. Net worth totals, how the portfolio is split, or the individual assets. Percentages are within each currency. When partial, warnings, unknown counts or unreachable spaces are present, say «parcial» or «desconocido» explicitly. Cost-basis fallback is an estimate; a null normalized total is unknown. Explain FX provenance when reporting a converted total. When pending_accounting.operation_count > 0, totals are provisional: say the updating status and queued operation count in the user’s language, never present them as final. Holding lines and allocation percentages may still reflect posted accounting.

space.description: Space name, e.g. "Personal". Omit to cover every space the user has.

view.description: networth = totals. allocation = the split. assets = what they own.
